name: Universite du Quebec Rimouski
overview:
ADDITIONAL PROGRAMME SPECIFICS

  • Programme fee of 7 200€ for non French/Belgian nationalities


UNIVERSITY OF QUEBEC AT RIMOUSKI

A young and dynamic French-speaking university, the University of Quebec at Rimouski (UQAR) offers varied training at the three university programs, including training unique to Canada and North America.

A member of the University of Quebec, the largest university network in Canada with 86,000 students, UQAR remains a university on a human scale. Present on two campuses, in Rimouski and Lévis, it welcomes approximately 5,800 students, including more than 300 non-Canadian students.

The human dimension of the University, the quality of the laboratories, the availability of professors and staff, the richness of student life, and the development of an exchange network for your career... these are some examples of what characterizes UQAR.


The reception service for non-Canadian students ensures your integration into your new environment, in collaboration with the Association of International Students, the MultiCultural Committee, and our regional partners.


The Rimouski and Lévis campuses are located on the south shore of the St. Lawrence River, near green spaces and administrative and commercial services. Our two campuses offer a wide variety of services on site to meet your needs, wherever you come from, including:

  • A cash point
  • Sports facilities
  • Catering providers
  • A bookstore
  • Reprographic and housing assistance services
Note: The Lévis campus does not offer accommodation.

To find out more advice for travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on the host country, click here
administrative:
1. Application Dossier

You will work directly with the partner university regarding your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see the Americas Teams channel for each application deadline).


If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet — please be patient.


To be given to EPITECH bachelor campus administration to reenroll for the Tech4 (in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.

Additionally, please note that there are additional tuition fees on the side of the partner university that you need to take into account: 1300€ for French and Belgian students and 7800€ for non-French and non-Belgian students.


2. Visa

The steps must be taken immediately upon acceptance from UQAR, because the procedures can be very long.


Once you have your UQAR admission letter, you must obtain:

- Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ)

Issued by the Government of Quebec (at the expense of the student: 108 $ CA)

  • It is possible to apply online or by paper, but we boldly recommend doing it online.
  • You will then have to send the required documents by post to the Canadian Immigration Department.
  • You must provide a bank letter proving your financial resources for the year abroad.


Helpful links (step-by-step guides):

  • Steps to take: http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/immigrer-installer/etudiants/obériment-autorisations/index. html
  • http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/immigrer-installer/etudiant/index.html
  • Apply for a CAQ: http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/immigrer-installer/etudiant/obériment-autorisations/certificat-acceptation/index.html
  • This request for a Quebec acceptance certificate requires approximately 4 weeks of processing time: http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/services/caq-electronique/index.html
  • Documents to provide: http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/immigrer-installer/etudiant/obériment-autorisations/certificat-acceptation/index.html
  • Proof of financial capacity required: http://www.immigration-quebec.gouv.qc.ca/fr/immigrer-installer/etudiant/obériment-autorisations/conditions-requises/capacite-financiere.html#prêtes
PLEASE NOTE:
A bank letter in French declaring that you have the necessary resources for your year in Canada is necessary for the CAQ request.
In 2026, the requested amount is 24 617 $ CAD for living expenses, plus relocation and travel costs.
If the bank letter is not in the student's name, submit a declaration of financial support:
Financial support form – D09.pdf

- Study Permit

Issued by the Government of Canada (at the expense of the student: 150 $ CA)

  • Apply at the official site
  • As a reference: Checklist of supporting documents (2017)
  • Processing time is approximately 5 to 8 weeks:
  • More info
Additional details for the study permit:
  • Indicate the designated educational institution (PST) from:
  • Institution list
  • On form IMM1294f, indicate level of study as "University Baccalaureate".
  • The permanent code on your UQAR acceptance letter corresponds to your student number — include it in your application.
  • If biometric data is requested, submit it in Lyon or Paris:
  • Biometric info


- Electronic Travel Authorization (AVE)

Since January 2016, all French students must obtain an AVE.

This number is normally included with the Study Permit. If not, request it online:

  • Apply for AVE
  • Cost: 7 $
  • Processing time: 72 hours
Reminder: Start your CAQ application as soon as you receive your admission letter. Delays may result in refusal of entry.

Full preparation guide: Programmes d'études (uqar.ca)


3. International Insurance

- Basic Social Protection

There is a specific agreement between France and Quebec for basic social protection on site for students of French nationality.

  • File created upon acceptance; may take several months
  • Proof of social security affiliation in France is required


Before departure:

  • Request necessary documents and the SE 401-Q-106 form from your health insurance
  • The form will be pre-filled by EPITECH International Relations and available under “my media” on the intranet
  • Send it to the CPAM of your residence with all documents (see Yammer group)
Check the validity period indicated by the CPAM. If it doesn’t cover the entire stay, a renewal will be needed during the year.


Upon arrival in Quebec:

  • Register with the RAMQ using the validated SE 401-Q-106 form
  • This grants access to RAMQ health care, maternity insurance, and CSST coverage (work-related accidents)
Important: Submit your RAMQ certificate to the UQAR administration or you may be charged for the university’s own international insurance and face late penalties.


- Complementary International Insurance

You must also take out private international insurance covering medical/hospital costs and repatriation.

Preferred providers:

  • ACS – Sandra Zagzag: szagzag@acs-ami.com / 01.40.47.91.02
  • AVI – Afida Koucha: akoucha@avi-international.com / 01.44.63.51.32
  • ISIS – Christine Barrat: christine.barrat@creassur-adc.com
  • Extrapass – international@extrapass.fr / 04.26.31.79.07 (promo code: EPITECH09 valid until December 2017)
  • Chapka – info@chapka.fr / 01 74 85 50 50 (promo code: EPITECH10)
Clearly state that you are an EPITECH student to receive a preferential rate.
Foreign students must subscribe to UQAR’s international student insurance.


4. Prepare Your Arrival

If you arrive at Montréal-Trudeau airport between August 4 and September 1, you can use the Accueil Plus service to reduce waiting time for your study permit:

http://www.accueilplus.ca/?lang=fr

For RAMQ, transportation, accommodation, and general info:

UQAR Student Info Page

Additional Recommendations:

  • Register on the French register established abroad via:
  • Ariane platform
  • Bring two pieces of ID (passport, ID card, driver's license) — required for administrative procedures such as renting, banking, etc.


Campus Life

Rimouski Campus

  • Very quiet and peaceful – great for relaxing and nature walks
  • Located at the mouth of the Saint Lawrence River, offering recreational activities like whale watching, boating, etc.
  • Fairly rural – a car is recommended
  • UQAR organizes extracurricular outings (e.g., visits to a maple syrup factory)
  • Low cost of living compared to France
  • UQAR housing is affordable (~270 euros/month) and well-equipped
Note: Eastern Québec has recently experienced a housing shortage. Dormitories may be full — students might need to find apartments or alternative housing. New residence halls are being built.

Lévis Campus

  • More urban, directly across the Saint Lawrence River from Québec City
  • Housing is more available, but mainly in apartments (no residence halls)
accomodation:
Temporary accommodation on arrival

It is possible by identifying yourself as a UQAR student to take advantage of temporary accommodation at reasonable prices at the Auberge Internationale (307 St-Germain Est). The time it takes to acquire your accommodation or if you arrive overnight in Rimouski, we recommend that you book your first two nights at Motel Rimouski.(410, St-Germain East)

RATES: standard student room with 2 double beds = 85$/night until mid-October. 60$/night after mid-October. No additional cost if you are two students sharing the room.

Service included: wireless internet, telephone, television, small refrigerator, private bathroom. No meal service or kitchen on site, but the Motel is located near the Carrefour shopping center and the Normandin restaurant.

Transport: 25 minutes 'walk from UQAR and 5 minutes' walk from Orléans Express bus station.

Taxi: (418.723.3344) approximately 8.00$CA for a trip from Motel Rimouski to UQAR.

 

On-campus accommodation

You can check the following page: https://www.uqar.ca/services/services-a-l-etudiant/logements

If you wish to apply for accommodation on the Rimouski campus, you can do so upon admission to university at http://residencesuqar.com/

For a room, expect to pay about 250 euros. UQAR offers a formula with 4 bedrooms per apartment. The rooms are 9m² and are considered quite spacious. The apartment has a functional kitchen (oven/hob/fridge/freezer/storage), bright and furnished common rooms (tables/chairs/sofas)

Please note, you will be asked to send an international money order corresponding to the amount of the first month's rent (by your bank, or by post where you must fill out a form and send the amount in cash) so that your reservation can be taken into account.

The cancellation and reimbursement conditions for this amount are indicated on the residences website.

With regard to the Lévis campus, there are no residences like in Rimouski, contact the UQAR student services, they can answer you regarding accommodation in Lévis.https://www.uqar.ca/services/student-services/accommodation? slider=campus-de-levis


Off-campus accommodation

We recommend that you do not confirm an accommodation reservation or rent payment before their arrival in Rimouski. Once there, your students will be able to visit the accommodation they have pre-selected and then sign a rental contract. Student Services will be able to support them in their efforts. However, they will have to pay for temporary accommodation the time it takes to find alternate accommodation.


To start the search, we recommend the following link : https://uqar.ca/services/services-a-l-etudiant/logements


Here are some basics about housing:

  • Housing division:

The number before the “½” indicates the number of rooms making up the accommodation and the “½” represents the bathroom. For example, for your family, explore the prices of housing types 4 ½ and 5 ½. Housing 4 ½ = 4 rooms (2 bedrooms, 1 kitchen and 1 living room) + 1 bathroom.

Housing 5 ½ = 5 rooms (3 bedrooms, 1 kitchen and 1 living room) + 1 bathroom.


  • Heating and electricity:

In the ad, if it says "n-ch, n-é" it means that neither heating nor electricity is included in the monthly payments and therefore, that you will have to pay your electricity bill. You can therefore assess an additional 80$ to 120$ per month which will be added to your monthly fees.

Some units include heating and electricity, which means that the rent is fixed and includes these services.

Always ask the landlord if lighting and heating (electricity) costs are included in your rent.


  • Furniture:

In Quebec, a “semi-furnished” type apartment only includes a stove and a refrigerator (appliances). You will then need to find a table, a bed and other furniture.

Most Rimouski apartments are "unfurnished". You will then have to furnish it entirely.

It is very rare to find furnished apartments in Quebec.


  • Telecommunications

In Quebec, telecommunication services operate on a flat rate basis and are usually the responsibility of the tenant. You should allow 100$ to 120$ per month for a basic trio. The basic trios include a landline, internet connection and cable TV. Telephone calls operate on a flat rate basis. Local calls (from Rimouski to Rimouski) are free, but long distance and overseas calls are charged. Telecommunication services are much more expensive than in Europe and some cell phones in other countries do not work in Quebec.


For the Lévis campus, we also invite you to view the announcements on https://www.kijiji.ca/b-immobilier/grand-montreal/c34l80002
courses:
Academic Program at UQAR

Local Credits Requirement

  • Number of local credits to be earned per year: 30
  • i.e. 15 credits per semester

The course at UQAR lasts two semesters and is taught in French.


Semester Dates:

  • First semester: August to December
  • Second semester: January to April


You can consult the academic calendar here:

https://www.uqar.ca/etudes/etudier-a-l-uqar/calendrier-universitaire


Program Options for EPITECH Students

Students have the option of following either the computer major program or its computer certificate program.

UQAR accepts:

  • Students with a GPA between 2 and 2.49 for the certificate
  • Students with a GPA of 2.5 and above for the major


Here is the list of courses available for EPITECH students : UQAR courses.


1. Major in Computer Science

Possibility of obtaining a certificate. The course description can be found here for the major


Requirements to validate the major:

  • Satisfy the general regulations of the University of Quebec and the regulations of the University
  • Validate the 30 credits of the program. You must take a maximum of 10 modules over the year (5 per semester) totaling 30 local credits to obtain 60 ECTS credits.
  • Plan on having a consequential workload (2 to 3 practical works + 2 exams per course)
  • Have a 2.0/4.3 GPA (only calculated on the grades obtained at the university)
  • No outstanding fees due to the University

Goals:

Acquire or consolidate knowledge in general, from the design, development and management of IT projects. The technologies seen depend on the subjects and the teachers, their preferred fields generally being the Web (Asp.net, Java), databases (all types) and system software (C ++, Java, C #, Erlang, etc.). Mobile applications are not part of the program.


2. Certificate in Computer Science

Possibility of obtaining a certificate. The course description can be found here for the certificate.


Conditions for obtaining the certificate:

  • Satisfy the general regulations of the University of Quebec and the regulations of the University
  • Validate the 30 credits of the program
  • Have no outstanding fees due to the University
  • Have 2.0/4.3 GPA (only calculated on the grades obtained at the university)


Goals:

Acquire knowledge related to the fields of programming, software engineering and databases.

Develop skills related to the design, development and deployment of distributed systems.


Internship

It is not possible to do an internship, but it is possible to meet companies during a forum. There are also visits organized by the university and by the organization of Québec International and its 10X10 program.


Campus Selection

Students may choose between the Rimouski or the Lévis campus. The Epitech International Relations office will ask you to indicate your choice after you are placed at UQAR.


Attendance and Course Availability

Please note: Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of loss of visa and repatriation to France at the student's expense (impact on credits). The courses are much more theoretical and based on classical instruction than at Epitech.

The course list is given to you for information. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.


Application and Program Allocation

During the selection in January, the student must apply directly to the destination and not to a specific program. The University of Quebec at Rimouski remains the decision-maker on the allocation of students to the programs after studying their application.

UQAR accepts students with a GPA between 2 and 2.49 for the certificate and a 2.5 GPA and above for the major.


Tuition Fees

Epitech will pay the tuition fees at UQAR to the extent of the 10 modules required per year (i.e. 5 per semester) to allow you to acquire the necessary credits. Any additional module you wish to take will be at your expense.


EIP

Any Tech 4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of your free time to work on this.
cost:
Estimated Budget:

  • Paris–Quebec round trip flights: 800 euros
  • Bus Québec – Rimouski: 65$ CA one way
  • Or round trip flights Paris–Montreal: 800 euros
  • Bus Montreal – Rimouski: 90$ CA one way
  • CAQ: CA$ 108
  • Study permit: 150$ CA
  • Adapted clothing for winter in Quebec: 500$
  • Graduation: 50$
  • Housing:
  • 370$ CA (room on the Rimouski campus)
  • Between 400 and 700$ CA (approximately) rent for accommodation that you will need to find for the Lévis campus
  • Food and hygiene: 250 $/month
  • Telephone, Internet, etc.: around 70$/month
  • Books and school materials: about 250 $
  • Personal expenses, leisure, clothing (other than winter equipment): about 120 $/month
  • Transportation:
  • Rimouski students have nearby facilities and their transportation costs amount to 0 $CA.
  • For Lévis, different formulas exist. Some students prefer to have the autonomy of a car, others prefer to use public transportation.
  • Expect to pay about 70$CA per month for the youth fare, which gives access to the bus service in the Lévis region as well as the ferry which goes to Quebec.
  • The amount is 90$CA/month for the normal rate and there is a fare that covers Quebec + Lévis for a few dollars more.
  • Outings/leisure (optional): between 100/200$ CA/month
  • The university offers printing facilities and document scans for a few dollars. Although these are credited virtually, you musn't forget to settle payment before the end of each session (or before).


Please note: the university will offer you various medical, dental and other insurance options during your orientation week. If you do not wish to subscribe to these, you must indicate this to the university. Otherwise, these costs will be billed directly to you. They will not be covered by Epitech.


As an indication, the cost of these insurances is between 55 to 350$ CAN per semester.


The health and dental insurance offered by student associations (AGECALE – Lévis or AGECAR – Rimouski) will automatically appear on an online invoice:

If the student wishes to keep them, they must pay them directly at UQAR.


However, if the student does not wish to keep them, they have until October 10 to withdraw from the insurer.

  • If the student is studying at the Lévis Campus, they must cancel this at:
  • http://aseq.ca/View.aspx?locale=fr&uid=wwwsanteetudiantecom_AGECALE_Home&.
  • If the student is studying on the Rimouski Campus, they must cancel this at:
  • https://planmajor.ca/fr/associations/agecar/.


Also, do not forget to present your Q106 form completed by the social security to benefit from the RAMQ, otherwise foreign student insurance costs will be billed to you.


Student associations can also determine compulsory new contributions at any time during the academic year, and this will not be covered by EPITECH.

These prices are indicative, they may vary.
